title: Neon
slide_intent: Give an invisible service a visible metaphor so people can picture connection across places and devices.
strategic_value: Magenta neon can link T-Mobile’s network message to its established color while adding spatial drama.
demonstration: A collage combines a neon T, city and neighborhood lighting, a device interaction, beams and a glowing US outline.
practical_value: Use neon as a supporting network cue while retaining flat magenta as the primary color treatment.

content_islands.name: Metaphor and scope
content_islands.spec: Explain network connection and the supplemental-treatment boundary in the left column.

content_islands.name: Neon example collage
content_islands.spec: Arrange the large outlined T beside environmental and device examples, with beams and graphic outlines below.

ingredient.name: Magenta neon
ingredient.role: Make network connection visible through light tracing environments.
ingredient.application: Use as an accent; in motion let it follow landscape, building and road contours. Keep flat magenta primary.
ingredient.scope: Static and motion network expression; this PDF contains still examples, not playable animation.
